notes.title: We got featured on Independent Televised Videotapes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162791/2d980a0c4aba5617e256f2787bcef61fc4437792.jpg[/img]

This is soooo nice!  🥹😍🥰

"Добро пожаловать to Dimitri’s Tape No. 27 of Independent Televised Videotapes; your highly unstable, fully magnetic transition broadcast of independent gaming excellence, proudly smuggled out from the glorious CRT-lit tunnels of 24indie." 💥☄️

These fellas put out an excellent video review of Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters and executed it with extreme style (and hilarity!). Can't wait to see more of their vids! 🏅🪘

Go watch it here:
🤙🏻 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pH97_T-s2x8

And don't forget to subscribe to their channel!!  😊

notes.title: SEAGO 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162791/a6c78ce630317726420b7a40eadc23c896075687.jpg[/img]

This is old news! But good news!

Our game Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters was featured on #SEAGO 2024 along with so many amazing games from SEA! 🎉

As proud representatives of the Philippines (and Steam indie dev noobies) we were so excited to participate in this event! 🇵🇭

Don't forget to wishlist our game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3163740/

Huge thanks to @SEAGamethetic Virtual SEA PlayPrime THE MAGIC RAIN and IGG Philippines for putting this event together! ❤️
